parts.premise:
1

The ranges come from a National PTA and NEA parent guide. It caps grades K–2 at 10 to 20 minutes a day. It says grades 3–6 can handle 30 to 60 minutes.

2

Educators often call the PTA and NEA ranges the Ten Minute Rule (Cooper, 2001). The part of the guide Cooper quotes gives ranges, not a formula.

3

For elementary students, Cooper (2001) called homework's effect on school results "trivial, if it exists at all." He warns that a link is not proof of cause.

4
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend 10 minutes of homework for kindergarten students.
